ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.

2. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.

3. When practising Intensive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

7. When practising Conversational Skills: Interviews, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills: Interviews.

8. When practising Public Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Public Speaking.

9. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Public Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Conversational Skills: Interviews and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
